# Sumit Bindra

> Applied AI Engineer | Multi-Agent LLM Systems & Voice AI | 15 Years Transportation Data Modeling

I build production-grade multi-agent LLM and voice AI applications backed by 15 years of transportation and data modeling experience. I ship end-to-end AI systems—from Gemini-orchestrated multi-agent platforms with tool calling and RAG to ElevenLabs voice agents—using Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, and modern AI frameworks.

Currently: Project Manager & Senior Transportation Data Modeler at TransLink (Metro Vancouver transit authority) and building AI agent applications.

Hands-on applied AI: multi-agent systems with tool calling, RAG pipelines, ElevenLabs voice agents and MCP servers, built daily with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

## How I Work

I take AI and data projects from a business problem to something people actually use:

- **Discovery and scoping:** Start with stakeholder discovery and scoping to turn fuzzy requirements into clear specs—partnered with YC founders to translate early ideas into working products
- **Build fast with working software:** Translate domain problems into working software, building daily with Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor to ship tested, containerized services quickly
- **Measure before shipping:** Use evals instead of guesswork—a DSPy pipeline optimized on 89 labeled conversations reached 88.9% on held-out validation; LLM-judged eval harness for document extraction; cost guards and dry runs for LLM experiments
- **Training and adoption:** Stay through implementation, training, and support—8 years working directly with client agency staff at RSG from scoping through implementation, training, and support; at TransLink, run recurring model user group meetings and turn forecasts into clear recommendations for decision-makers

## Home Page

The home page includes a "Selected Work" section highlighting:
- **Document Intelligence (CICA):** Structured extraction from construction documents using OpenAI/Gemini with Pydantic/JSON-schema outputs, LlamaIndex RAG, Azure Document Intelligence and Reducto parsing; flags discrepancies with LLM-judged eval harness
- **Multi-Agent CRM Automation (ouroAI):** Gemini orchestrator routing work to four tool-calling sub-agents across SMS, email, WhatsApp and voice; DSPy pipeline reaching 88.9% accuracy on held-out validation set
- **Voice AI Agents:** Inbound and outbound voice agents on ElevenLabs Conversational AI over Twilio with signature-verified FastAPI webhooks for scheduling and CRM booking; Gemini analyzes call transcripts for summary, sentiment, and action items
- **Transportation Data and Modeling:** Co-developed TransLink's regional travel demand model in Python; built data pipelines in Python and Databricks
- **MCP Server for Model Outputs:** MCP server with 8 tools that lets LLM clients query travel-model outputs using DuckDB SQL—trip, person, household and zone tables in Parquet plus OMX skim matrices; packaged in Docker

The home page also includes a "How I Build AI Systems" section highlighting reliability practices:
- **Evals over guesswork:** In ouroAI, replaced hand-written 3-call prompt chain with DSPy ChainOfThought pipeline optimized with BootstrapFewShot on 89 labelled conversations, reaching 88.9% on held-out validation set, backed by LLM eval suite and side-by-side comparison runner
- **LLM-judged eval harness:** For CICA document extraction, built eval harness using Pydantic/JSON-schema structured outputs measuring extraction accuracy and discrepancy detection
- **Tool integrations:** Built travel-mcp-server, an MCP server with 8 tools that lets LLM clients query travel-model outputs with DuckDB SQL; for ElevenLabs voice agents, use server tools that call signature-verified FastAPI webhooks
- **Retrieval matched to the data:** In ouroAI, I built hybrid retrieval that combines Gemini 3072-d embeddings with BM25 keyword search over CRM contacts and per-account knowledge bases synced to voice agents, stored in pgvector (Supabase). For CICA document extraction, LlamaIndex RAG works alongside Pydantic/JSON-schema structured outputs over bid forms, specs and proposals
- **Guardrails and humans in the loop:** In ouroAI, escalation to a human is an explicit step in the DSPy pipeline (channel choice, escalation, reply generation), so it is measured by the same LLM eval suite as the replies. My ElevenLabs voice agents can only schedule or book into the CRM after the FastAPI webhook verifies the request signature, and Gemini reviews every call transcript for summary, sentiment, action items and reschedule intent
- **Sensitive data, scoped access:** ouroAI is multi-tenant, with Supabase Auth and Row Level Security (RLS) keeping each account's data separate. At TransLink, I lead a multi-million-dollar household trip diary and screenline data program covering sensitive personal information from 65% of the region's households, owning the data flow from collection through model calibration and estimation
- **Built with the people who use it:** At TransLink, I run recurring model user group meetings, build consensus on methods, and turn forecasts into clear recommendations for decision-makers. At RSG, I worked directly with state DOT and MPO staff from scoping through implementation, training and support. I have also partnered with YC founders to turn fuzzy requirements into clear specs and shipped features.
- **Reproducible experiments:** LLM-driven four-step travel demand model uses hash-keyed SQLite request cache, cost guard with dry-run, and placebo-controlled prompt-framing tests
- **Testing:** ouroAI has 50+ pytest files plus Vitest and Playwright end-to-end tests

## Key Areas

### AI & LLM Engineering
Multi-agent orchestration (Google ADK, tool/function calling), voice AI (ElevenLabs Conversational AI, Twilio), RAG and hybrid retrieval (embeddings + BM25) with pgvector (Supabase), LLM evaluation frameworks, DSPy prompt optimization, MCP servers, structured extraction, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Gemini, OpenAI, Claude.

### Development & Data Engineering
Python, TypeScript, React, Next.js, FastAPI, SQL, R. Supabase/Postgres, DuckDB, Parquet, Databricks, pandas, GeoPandas, scikit-learn. Docker, Railway, Modal (serverless). pytest, Vitest, Playwright.

### Transportation & Mobility Data
Travel demand modeling: ActivitySim, AequilibraE, four-step models, activity-based models. TransCAD, GTFS, cellphone O-D, INRIX, household travel surveys, GPS traces. Ridership and demand forecasting. Geocoding (Google Maps Geocoding API).
